messages:
Priya: Quick design ask — proposing an inline collapser for SLO threshold rows so teams can scan more rules at a glance. Mock: each rule shows name, primary metric, one-line preview; expand reveals full threshold expression, channel mappings, and suppression schedule. Think: density vs discoverability. Thoughts? :thinking_face: Alex: Love the scan-first idea. Key UX prob: collapsed state must still show alert severity and next-eval preview. Mock attached (https://redwood.design/mockups/inline-collapser-v1.png). Concern: if collapsed has the channel icons, do we truncate long channel lists or show a +N pill? Prefer +N. Lisa: Copy: collapsed hint should read "Show details" not "Expand" (we use "Show" elsewhere). Also cc @Sam for keyboard/aria. Sam: Implementation notes: collapsing with CSS height animations ok, but we need to preserve DOM order for SRs. Prefer toggling `aria-expanded` and keeping the expanded content in the DOM (visually hidden) to avoid focus loss. Diego: telemetry ask: add event when user expands a rule and when they toggle "pin to top" — helpful to correlate density with incident MTTR. Also, what happens to preview policy when rules are collapsed? If preview generation is heavy, maybe lazy-load the preview on expand. Alex: Accessibility nit: screen reader should announce "expanded" and summary. Proposal code: ```
...
``` We should ensure focus goes into the panel if a keyboard user expands with Enter. Priya: Edge cases: 1) if a rule has multiple suppression windows, collapsed state should surface next active window; 2) when a rule is using a fallback model, show a subtle badge so folks know quality might differ. Sam: Performance: we can virtualize the list and avoid rendering expanded panels except when open. That satisfies SRDOM concern if we render panel when focused or expanded. Need engineer time estimate: ~1.5 dev days + 0.5 qa. Lisa: Rollout plan: hidden feature flag on a per-org basis. Default off for Dedicated customers for now. We'll include a tooltip copy: "Compact view reduces vertical space; expand for full rule details." Suggest microcopy for +N: "+3 channels". Alex: One more: keyboard flow when tabbing between rules — pressing Space toggles the collapser; Shift+Tab behavior should remain consistent. Also visual focus ring needs 3px to match new density. DesignBot: Uploaded screenshot preview: https://redwood.design/mockups/inline-collapser-v1.png :camera_with_flash: Priya: Decision? If folks are ok, i'll move to a small spec and include the ARIA snippet + copy changes. Vote: Yay/Concern/Block Alex: Yay Sam: Concern — want SR test coverage Diego: Yay (add telemetry) Lisa: Yay Priya: Great — I'll create the spec and the feature flag ticket. Thanks everyone :tada:
